style: Photorealistic smartphone photo, natural indoor lighting, candid and slightly grainy like a real Instagram photo. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or readable screens anywhere in the image. The person is an ordinary original person, not resembling any celebrity.

prompts.name: kk_stock_sweat
prompts.prompt: A Korean man in his late 20s sitting on a living room sofa at night, wearing a grey hoodie, holding his smartphone with both hands close to his face, staring at it in frozen shock. Cold sweat on his forehead, pale face, eyes wide, lips pressed, as if he just saw his stock account crash. The phone screen glows with a vague red and blue light, no readable content. Messy coffee table with an energy drink can. Realistic, slightly funny despair.
